extracted.name: Cinnamon Apples
extracted.description: These warm cinnamon apples are such an easy, delicious fall treat! Serve them as a side dish or simple dessert, or top them onto ice cream, oatmeal, pancakes, or French toast. Find more serving suggestions in the post above.
ingredient_lines: 5 apples (peeled, cored, and cut into 1-inch pieces)
instruction_lines: Combine the apples, water, and vinegar in a saucepan, cover, and simmer over very low heat, stirring occasionally to make sure the apples don’t burn on the bottom of the pan, for 15 minutes.
Uncover, stir, and add the cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt and stir again. The apples should be tender and the juices should be thick.
Serve warm from the stove or store in the fridge for up to 4 days. Find our favorite serving suggestions in the post above.
